title: On the Spectra of Generalized Token Graphs of Stars
summary: In the generalization of token graphs (or supertoken graphs), the vertices of a $k$-token graph of a graph $G$ correspond to $k$ distinguishable or indistinguishable tokens placed on $k$ different or equal vertices of $G$. In several cases, we provide the whole spectrum of a supertoken graph of a star by analyzing its regular partitions.
